If you’re a woman they’re shockingly out of date with current research and treatments. Didn’t have a period for over one year many years ago, and was told you don’t really need one, despite guidance saying your period should be induced as you risk endometrial cancer otherwise. Had some tests done, but they referred me for the wrong type of ultrasound so the cysts on my ovaries weren’t picked up. Blood tests showed abnormal levels of certain hormones, and according to the Rotterdam criteria they had all they needed to diagnose me with PCOS. However, a certain GP who’s now retired lied to my face when I asked about the blood test results and told me they are normal, to just go on the pill to induce my period, despite me saying I can’t go on the pill due to the side effects and despite there being other ways to induce a period, and to come back when I want to have a baby. I didn’t find out about this until over ten years later, when I first looked at my records online. I believed for over a decade that I was healthy, but I wasn’t. Fast forward and I go back to them for the same issues, and now I get my diagnosis. But I get no offer of any treatment such as metformin, despite this being a fairly established treatment for PCOS. I get no referral for a face to face appointment with a gynaecologist or endocrinologist to discuss treatments and how I should manage my symptoms. I finally got a metformin prescription, but that’s only because the fertility specialist I saw recommended it to my GP. Again, metformin is not just to help fertility, it’s also to help various PCOS symptoms. I’m sad that even 10 years after being fobbed off and lied to I’m still treated as an incubator and like my symptoms aren’t worth treating for my own sake and health, my only value apparently lies in having babies, it’s only then it’s worth treating. Additionally, they aren’t following the NICE guidelines regarding inducing periods and offering OGTT to PCOS patients. Also had symptoms of adenomyosis and endometriosis but only got an IBS diagnosis instead. Again, it’s only thanks to the fertility specialist that I now have a laparoscopy coming up to finally investigate whether I have these conditions or not. Not just for fertility reasons but for my own wellbeing.

Other than this I’ve had multiple other bad experience with this practice. Receptionists refusing to offer me appointments for potentially serious conditions including when I had light sensitivity and blurred vision, being prescribed medications incompatible with other medications and medical conditions I take and have, being gaslighted and being fobbed off ad infinitum. I can literally print the NICE guidelines and clinical studies and take with me backing up my claims and why I need certain referrals and treatments, and I’m still fobbed off. My clinical records are full of factual errors as well, and when I request them to change them I’m ignored. Tried to complain but got nowhere, didn’t even get an apology.

My advice to any poor soul who ends up seeking treatment here is to record what’s said at all appointments and all phone calls to the receptionist. The staff at this practice repeatedly acts as if I’m lying about what truly happened, and you might need proof as they never believe what you say. If you’re denied treatment or referral, ask them to make a note in your records that they denied you and why. And lastly, just avoid being poor so that you can seek proper care privately. Ironically, despite this taking the pressure of the practice and the NHS in general, the staff at this practice appears to dislike it when patients go private, I guess they just want you to be miserable and under their power and control.",null,[0,240]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKQ2d6NC1TdjZQSGlBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf583a398374d288f!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEJCgz4-Sv6PHiAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKQ2d6NC1TdjZQSGlBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VKQ2d6NC1TdjZQSGlBRRItChdDSUhNMG9nS0VLekFoNjJ3eVpDWGtnRRISQ2dzSXM4VHh3UVlRdU1hb0pRGi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUtYQTlzRzJ2T0MzNVFFEhJDZ3NJczhUeHdRWVF1TWFvSlEiEgkAAAAAAAAAABGPKE03mKOD9SoSQ2dzSXM4VHh3UVlRdU1hb0pR&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj3qNrN7q-TAxWnJHsEHR-CKbYQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwj3qNrN7q-TAxWnJHsEHR-CKbYQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMnBWU1Vkb05WOWZSV2hCWW01bk9FdFRSRkl6TlRnek4zSm9UVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpvV1VOaFRsRm5ZVWhyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURndG95RnJRRRAB",["0x0:0xf583a398374d288f",null,1740410802488944,1740410802488944,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106969563061261269586/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Lee Gallacher","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU2dfTak8f7kOI9cjGzeDmOIAZwViV6Lu1-3ZwHx_Do9JmhhaU2=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106969563061261269586?hl=en"],"106969563061261269586",null,39,32,null,[1,5,1],2,["Local Guide · 39 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj3qNrN7q-TAxWnJHsEHR-CKbYQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Recently moved to the area and really impressed with the surgery staff.
